scripts.dev:cloudflare: npm run build:dev && wrangler dev --env development
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run content && npm run build:dev && npm run verify && wrangler deploy --env development
scripts.deploy:production: npm run content && npm run build:production && npm run verify && wrangler deploy --env production
scripts.check:syntax: node --check public/app.js && node --check public/sw.js && node --check src/worker.js && node --check public/admin/admin.js
scripts.verify: npm run check:syntax && npm run check && npm run check:offline && npm run check:admin
scripts.mobile:ios: npm run mobile:sync && cap open ios
scripts.mobile:android: npm run mobile:sync && cap open android
